## Entry type

Structure holding the entry portion of a chain record.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Entry = {
    entry_type: "Agent";
    entry: AgentPubKey;
} | {
    entry_type: "App";
    entry: AppEntryBytes;
} | {
    entry_type: "CounterSign";
    entry: [CounterSigningSessionData, AppEntryBytes];
} | {
    entry_type: "CapClaim";
    entry: CapClaim;
} | {
    entry_type: "CapGrant";
    entry: ZomeCallCapGrant;
};
```
